title.zh: 将北甘马磷省 Capalonga 市镇的 Ilayang Basiad 小区改设为该市镇圣佩德罗描笼涯的法案
title.en: An Act Converting the Sitio of Ilayang Basiad in the Municipality of Capalonga, Province of Camarines Norte, into Barrio San Pedro of Said Municipality
title.orig: An Act Converting the Sitio of Ilayang Basiad in the Municipality of Capalonga, Province of Camarines Norte, into Barrio San Pedro of Said Municipality
title.vi: Đạo luật chuyển đổi khu dân cư Ilayang Basiad thuộc thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh Capalonga, tỉnh Camarines Norte thành thôn San Pedro của thành phố trực thuộc tỉnh này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนแปลงสถานที่อิลายังบาเซียดในเขตเทศบาลกาปาโลงกาจังหวัดกามารีเนสโนร์เตเป็นบารังไกย์ซานเปโดรของเทศบาลดังกล่าว
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Sitio Ilayang Basiad di Kotamadya Capalonga, Provinsi Camarines Norte menjadi Barrio San Pedro di Kotamadya tersebut
title.ms: Akta menukar Sitio Ilayang Basiad dalam Perbandaran Capalonga, Wilayah Camarines Norte kepada Barrio San Pedro bagi Perbandaran berkenaan

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1955/ra_1316_1955.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The sitio of Ilayang Basiad in the Municipality of Capalonga, Province of Camarines Norte, is converted into barrio San Pedro of said municipality.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 16, 1955.
